title: What the game does for the player: Arisen vs a played pawn (hit-stop, slow-mo, sound)
intro: Watch-only test, nothing is changed. Party around you, a Fighter or Warrior main pawn is ideal. Start as the ARISEN (not playing a pawn). Press End to start.

steps.each_frame:
-- player-feel logger (installed once by the plan; watch-only: every hook returns the game's own result)
if not G_pf then
  G_pf = { log = {}, n = 0, t0 = os.clock() }
  local L = G_pf
  local function goname(o)
    if not o then return nil end
    local n
    pcall(function()
      local td = o:get_type_definition():get_full_name()
      if td == "via.GameObject" then n = o:call("get_Name") else n = o:call("get_GameObject"):call("get_Name") end
    end)
    return n and tostring(n) or nil
  end
  local function who_in(o) -- every object-typed field of a hit record that names a game object
    local r = {}
    pcall(function()
      for _, f in ipairs(o:get_type_definition():get_fields()) do
        if not f:is_static() then
          local okv, v = pcall(o.get_field, o, f:get_name())
          if okv and type(v) == "userdata" and v.get_type_definition then
            local nm = goname(v)
            if nm then r[f:get_name()] = nm end
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    return r
  end
  local function add(e)
    if L.n >= 600 then return end
    L.n = L.n + 1
    e.t = math.floor((os.clock() - L.t0) * 100) / 100
    pcall(function() local d = _G.DPC_dbg; e.played = d and d.state and d.state.active and tostring(d.state.pawn_name) or "Arisen" end)
    L.log[#L.log + 1] = e
    if L.n % 10 == 0 or e.k ~= "hitstop" then pcall(json.dump_file, "test_guide/player_feel_log.json", L.log) end
  end
  local function hookm(tn, sig, pre, post)
    local t = sdk.find_type_definition(tn)
    local m = t and t:get_method(sig)
    if not m then add({ k = "missing", what = tn .. "." .. sig }); return end
    sdk.hook(m, function(args) pcall(pre, args) end, function(r) pcall(post or function() end, r); return r end)
  end
  -- hit-stop time chosen for a hit
  hookm("app.HitController", "getHitStopTime(app.HitController.DamageInfo)",
    function(args) local s = thread.get_hook_storage(); s.di = sdk.to_managed_object(args[3]); s.hc = sdk.to_managed_object(args[2]) end,
    function(r)
      local s = thread.get_hook_storage()
      local v = sdk.to_float(r)
      if s.di then add({ k = "hitstop", v = v, hit = goname(s.hc), who = who_in(s.di) }) end
      s.di = nil
    end)
  -- hit-stop applied to a work rate (whose)
  for _, sig in ipairs({ "setHitStop(System.Single, System.Single, System.Boolean)", "setHitStop(app.HitStopData.Work, System.Boolean)" }) do
    hookm("app.WorkRate", sig, function(args)
      local wr = sdk.to_managed_object(args[2])
      local e = { k = "setHitStop", on = goname(wr), sig = sig:sub(1, 22) }
      if sig:find("Single, System.Single") then e.a = sdk.to_float(args[3]); e.b = sdk.to_float(args[4]) end
      add(e)
    end)
  end
  -- monster death slow-motion
  for _, p in ipairs({ { "app.Ch200000", "isEnableWorldSlow(app.HitController.DamageInfo)" }, { "app.Ch261000", "isEnableWorldSlow(app.HitController.DamageInfo)" },
                       { "app.Ch200000", "checkDieWorldSlow(app.HitController.DamageInfo)" } }) do
    hookm(p[1], p[2], function(args) local s = thread.get_hook_storage(); s.ws = sdk.to_managed_object(args[3]); s.wo = sdk.to_managed_object(args[2]) end,
      function(r)
        local s = thread.get_hook_storage()
        local e = { k = p[2]:match("^(%w+)"), cls = p[1], mon = goname(s.wo), who = s.ws and who_in(s.ws) or nil }
        if e.k == "isEnableWorldSlow" then e.ret = (sdk.to_int64(r) & 1) == 1 end
        add(e)
      end)
  end
  hookm("app.Ch200000", "requestDieWorldSlow()", function(args) add({ k = "requestDieWorldSlow", mon = goname(sdk.to_managed_object(args[2])) }) end)
  hookm("app.Ch255000", "callDieWorldSlow()", function(args) add({ k = "callDieWorldSlow", mon = goname(sdk.to_managed_object(args[2])) }) end)
  -- slow actions in behaviour trees (perfect guard, etc.)
  for _, tn in ipairs({ "app.JustGuardHitSlow", "app.SlowAction" }) do
    hookm(tn, "start(via.behaviortree.ActionArg)", function(args)
      local e = { k = "slowAction", cls = tn }
      pcall(function() local act = sdk.to_managed_object(args[2]); e.on = goname(act) or tostring(act:get_type_definition():get_full_name()) end)
      add(e)
    end)
  end
  add({ k = "installed" })
end

steps.text: AS THE ARISEN: kill these goblins with heavy hits and skills. If you can, block / perfect-guard a hit.
Now TAKE OVER your main pawn (L1 + left stick click).
AS THE PAWN: kill these goblins the same way (heavy hits, skills, a block if you can).
Go back to the Arisen. Optional bonus: if a big monster is nearby, kill it once as the Arisen and once as the pawn on another day. Done.
